## Portfolio Case Studies
### Road Accident Analytics (2020–2025) (09/2026 – 10/2026)
- URL: https://www.akhilinsights.com/projects/kerala-road-accident-analysis/
- Tools: Python, SQL, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, Pandas
- Summary: Statistical investigation of 34,500+ traffic crash records across all 14 Kerala districts, pinpointing high-fatality districts and night-time risk.
- Cleaned 6 years of Kerala Police district-wise accident data from PDFs into a 114-row dataset, resolving inconsistent district reporting and reconciling totals against source.
- Found accidents rose 79% (2020 to 2025) while deaths rose only 25%; top 5 districts account for 39% of accidents, and Palakkad has the highest fatality rate (12.3 per 100) despite ranking 6th in volume.
- Built an interactive Power BI dashboard (KPI cards, YoY trends, district map, drill-downs) to guide enforcement and awareness spending.

### DataSentrix: Data Analytics Platform (01/2026 – Present)
- URL: https://www.akhilinsights.com/projects/datasentrix/
- Tools: Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Pandas, ECharts, Matplotlib, API, SQLite
- Summary: A web-based data analytics platform tested on a 200,000-row dataset with defined data cleaning rules, KPI metrics, charts and AI-assisted insights.
- Built a web-based analytics platform with dataset uploads, data cleaning, KPI metrics, charts, and AI-assisted insights.
- Tested on a 200,000-row dataset with defined data quality rules (duplicates, missing values, outliers); verified accuracy via functional testing against an existing tool.

### Bike Sales Analysis (08/2026 – 09/2026)
- URL: https://www.akhilinsights.com/projects/bike-sales-dashboard/
- Tools: Microsoft Excel, Pivot Tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, Slicers, KPI Cards
- Summary: Cleaned Kaggle bike sales dataset and created an interactive Excel dashboard showing how commute distance, education and geography drive purchase behavior.
- Cleaned a Kaggle dataset and built Pivot Tables, charts, and an interactive Excel dashboard to analyse sales patterns.
- Found North America drives ~57% of income and Pacific ~22%; analysed how commute distance and education affect bike purchases.

### What is Datasentrix?
Datasentrix is an automated data hygiene and reporting platform built by Akhil Shibu with Python, Django and SQL. It validates uploaded spreadsheets, drops records with null primary keys, isolates outliers with Z-scores and generates KPI reports, so teams stop repeating manual clean-up before every dashboard. Read the full write-up, including the problem, pipeline stages and tools, on the Datasentrix case study page.

### What did the Kerala road accident analysis find?
Across 34,500+ crash records covering all 14 Kerala districts, Thiruvananthapuram and Ernakulam together account for 29.1% of fatal crashes. Crashes between 20:00 and 04:00 show a fatality severity ratio 64.2% higher than the rest of the day, which points to night-time enforcement and lighting as priorities. The case study explains the data source, method and what "fatality severity ratio" means in plain English.

### How does Akhil approach data cleaning and ETL?
Akhil follows an 8-stage workflow: define the business objective, inspect the schema, validate and clean records, engineer features, model in SQL, build the BI dashboard, diagnose root causes and recommend actions. Cleaning rules are written as repeatable scripts rather than one-off manual edits, so results can be re-run. This workflow is implemented in code in the Datasentrix project.

### How does SQL help in data analytics?
SQL lets an analyst pull, filter, join and aggregate data directly from a database instead of copying spreadsheets. Window functions such as RANK() OVER rank rows within groups without collapsing them, which is how the Kerala road accident analysis ranks districts by fatal crashes. Queries are repeatable, so the same result can be regenerated when new data arrives.

### What is the difference between Power BI and Excel dashboards?
Excel dashboards use pivot tables, slicers and formulas inside a workbook, which suits small teams and quick analysis. Power BI uses a data model with DAX measures and shared reports, which scales better to larger datasets and many viewers. Akhil has built one of each. Compare the bike sales Excel dashboard with the Power BI work in the Kerala road accident analysis.

### What is an automated ETL pipeline?
An automated ETL pipeline extracts raw data from its sources, transforms it by validating and cleaning records, and loads the result into a store for reporting, all without manual steps. Datasentrix applies this idea to spreadsheets: schema checks, null-key removal and Z-score outlier flags run on every file. Because the rules are code, the output is repeatable and auditable.

### How does Python help with data cleaning?
Python with Pandas can find missing values, remove duplicates, standardise inconsistent labels and flag outliers in a few repeatable lines, replacing manual spreadsheet edits. In the Kerala road accident analysis, Pandas was used to standardise district names before the SQL ranking and Power BI visuals were built. Scripts can be re-run on new files, which keeps results consistent.

### What skills does a data analyst fresher need?
A data analyst fresher needs SQL joins, subqueries and CTEs, advanced Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP), one BI tool such as Power BI, Python with Pandas for data cleaning, basic statistics and data storytelling. Employers also value a portfolio that proves these skills on real datasets. Akhil demonstrates each skill on a case study page.

### How do I analyze road accident data using SQL window functions?
Clean the crash records first, then group by district and count fatal crashes. Add RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fatal_crashes DESC) to rank districts without collapsing rows, and use PARTITION BY to compare hours or years within a district. Akhil ranked districts this way on 34,500+ Kerala crash records.

### How do you build a Power BI dashboard from scratch?
Define the business question and KPIs, import and clean the data, then model it as a star schema with fact and dimension tables. Write DAX measures, add visuals with slicers and drill-downs, check the numbers against the source, and publish. Start with one page that answers one decision.
